records.title: QuAnTS: Question Answering on Time Series
records.reason: The primary arXiv text presents QuAnTS as a human-motion time-series QA dataset and baselines; it does not introduce LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Diff4Splat: Controllable 4D Scene Generation with Latent Dynamic Reconstruction Models
records.reason: The primary arXiv paper is a video-latent-transformer method for controllable 4D scene synthesis; its efficiency comparison concerns scene-generation workflow, not LLM inference.

records.title: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs): Empowering Drug Discovery
records.reason: The Wiley review covers LLM uses in drug discovery and development; it contributes application taxonomy and future directions, not serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Contextformer: A Transformer with Spatio-Channel Attention for Context Modeling in Learned Image Compression
records.reason: Contextformer is a learned image-compression entropy model using spatio-channel attention; its rate-distortion results do not address LLM serving.

records.title: FILM-QNN: Efficient FPGA Acceleration of Deep Neural Networks with Intra-Layer, Mixed-Precision Quantization
records.reason: FILM-QNN targets CNN models such as ResNet/MobileNet on embedded FPGA; mixed-precision quantization and hardware packing are relevant only as a weak hardware-transfer analogy, with no transformer/LLM evaluation.
